html:
Greetings, Agents.

 

This is CM Fragment of MARVEL Future Fight.

 

The heroes who once fought for justice now appear as zombies.

There’s an ominous aura surrounding them—what could have happened?

 

The theme of the October Update is inspired by the Marvel Studios’ <What If… Zombies?!>.

 

New Uniforms have been added for Captain America, Falcon, Doctor Strange, and Wong, who have turned into zombies due to the zombie virus that spread across the world.

 

Among them, Wong, proficient in magic and an expert in the martial arts of Kamar-Taj, has received a 

Tier-4 Advancement.

 

In addition, General Okoye of Wakanda has joined MARVEL Future Fight, preparing her Tier-3 power to prevent the world from falling into chaos.

 

The new content, Zombie Survival, where Agents must fend off hordes of zombies, has been added, and Alliance Battle has been improved.

 

Furthermore, various other improvements have been made to make the game more convenient to enjoy, 

so please check the details below!

 

▣ One New Hero

 

Check out the abilities of Okoye <What If… Zombies?!>, a brave warrior from Wakanda and a master of spearmanship.

* The hero skill effects are based on Lv.6 stats.

 

 

▣ Four New Uniforms

 

Four new Uniforms have been added in celebration of the Marvel Studios’ <What If… Zombies?!> inspired Update.

Check out the abilities of Captain America <What If… Zombies?!>, Falcon <What If… Zombies?!>, Doctor Strange <What If… Zombies?!>, and Wong <What If… Zombies?!>.

* New Uniform Skills are based on the following skill Level stats.

(Tier-4 heroes: Lv. 10, Others: Lv. 6)

* The four new Uniforms will be on sale for 40% off during the <October Update Celebration Event>, and can be checked and purchased in the Marvel Universe and Uniform Room after the event.

 

 

 

 

 

▣ Wong Tier-4

 

Tier-4 Advancement has been added to Wong, a wizard with extensive knowledge of magic, and also possesses excellent martial arts skills.

* The Tier-4 Striker Skill effects are based on Lv.6 stats.

 

 

▣ Okoye Tier-3

 

Okoye, the greatest warrior of Wakanda, has prepared her Tier-3 Ultimate Skill to protect the peace.

 

 

 

▣ M’Baku and Killmonger Potential Awakening & Transcendence

 

Through the October Update, M’Baku and Killmonger will acquire Potential Awakening & Transcendence!

* The skill effects are based on Lv.6 stats.

 

 

 

 

▣ New Content - Zombie Survival

 

With this update, ‘Zombie Survival’, a new content where Agents must survive against the rushing zombie horde for a set amount of time, has been added!

 

In the 9-Year Anniversary Development Team Letter of Appreciation, we informed you that we were preparing a new Multiplayer Content with the concept of blocking waves of enemies together. 

However, to provide a more stable service, the concept was changed to individual competitive content as a result of the review.

 

The goal of Zombie Survival is to survive and earn points by defeating zombies within a set time.

In order to clear the Level, heroes must defeat the boss, and at least one hero has to survive until the given time runs out.

 

Agents can participate in this content after meeting the requirements below.

- Unlock Requirements:

① Clear World Boss Legend <Knull> 1 time

② Own five or more Tier-3 & Potential Transcended heroes with Lv.70

 

 

- It can be accessed through [Enter] → [Challenge].

 

 

① My Info: Agents can check their ranking, highest score achieved, and the Rank.

- Compete with other Agents each week for higher rankings based on the score earned by defeating zombies.

- Ranking rewards include Zombie Survival Tokens.

② Skill Restriction: Restricted skills cannot be used in Zombie Survival. The list of restricted skills will change every season.

③ Stage Hazard: Depending on the stage, effects such as banned heroes, Zombie Enhancements, and map variables are added.

Stage Hazard changes every season with different effects.

④ Zombie Enhancement: As the stages progress, the zombies’ attack, defense, and HP are increased.

⑤ Challenges: Agents can earn Zombie Survival Tokens by completing weekly Challenges.

⑥ Store: Agents can use the Zombie Survival Tokens to purchase hero growth materials and other items in the Zombie Survival Shop.

 

* Zombie Survival initially opens up to Level 30. Once you clear Level 30, up to 60 Level will be unlocked.

 

5 heroes can be placed, including 2 Starting Members and 3 Reserved Members.

 

 

In each Level, normal zombies, a mid-boss zombie, and a boss zombie appear.

The goal is to defeat them within the given time to earn points.

 

- The boss zombie, which appears later in the battle, uses powerful skills along with the dialogue. Watch out for it!

 

At the end of the time limit, the results screen will display as follows, and the Agents’ performance can be checked.

* When failed to survive, the score will not be recorded.

 

Zombie Survival has its own set of Challenges.

By clearing the Challenges, Agents can earn currencies that can be used in the Zombie Survival Shop.

 

 

* More products will be added to the Zombie Survival Shop in the future.

 

 

▣ New Comic Cards and Collection

 

Five new Comic Cards with the <Marvel Zombies Return> theme have been added.

Collect these Comic Cards with powerful options and upgrade all of them to Mythic to acquire the

‘All Basic Attacks Increase +3%’ effect as a collection reward.

* The following Comic Cards can be acquired at the [Store] - [Dimension Chest] - [Comic Card Chest] 

after the October Update.

* Certain Marvel Zombies Return (2009) themed Comic Cards can also be obtained through gameplay.

* The [Marvel Zombies Return (2009) #1] cannot be acquired from the Premium Comic Card Chest that can be purchased with Premium Comic Card Exchange Tokens.

* The effects are based on the highest quality and rank.

 

* The Activation Rate option [HP Increases by +20%] of the Premium Comic Card 'Marvel Zombies Return (2009) #1' can be stacked with the same option of other Comic Cards.

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

▣ Alliance Battle Improvements

 

1. The UI related to boss information in Alliance Battle has been improved.

- The Instinct of the Boss is displayed on the Boss Info.

 

 

2. The maximum score of each mode has been increased.

[Extreme Mode]

- Before: 18,000,000 points

- After: 27,000,000 points

[Legend Mode]

- Before: 15,000,000 points

- After: 22,000,000 points

 

3. The higher score rewards have been added to the Extreme Mode and Legend Mode.

 

Premium Gift Box Pieces can be acquired from the Alliance Battle Chest.

Agents can produce the Premium Gift Box in the [Craft] by collecting Pieces.

- Various items such as Tier-4 Growth Materials, Odin’s Blessing, Premium Comic Card, and C.T.P. can be acquired from the Premium Gift Box.

Please check the detailed list in-game.

 

 

4. The visibility of Odin's Might in Alliance Battle Legend Mode has been improved to make them easier to recognize.

 

 

▣ New Artifacts

 

Exclusive Passive Skill Artifacts for Okoye, Falcon, and Killmonger will be added after the October Update.

* The skill effects are based on Lv.4 stats.

 

 

▣ New Future Pass Plus Season & Special Icons

 

A new season of Future Pass Plus will begin after the update.

 

[Future Pass Plus Rewards]

- Please note that the Future Pass Plus effects will apply immediately upon purchase and cannot be refunded.

- Future Pass Plus - Legendary / Mythic that has been unlocked will only be applied during the season the Pass was purchased, and the Pass rewards will only be available during the same season.

- The Future Pass Plus - Mythic can be purchased after purchasing the Future Pass Plus - Legendary.

- Future Pass Plus - Legendary / Mythic will not be available for purchase when the season is about to end. Please check the sale schedule in the game.

 

​​New Special Icons that will represent Agents have been added.
Collect two new Icons as Future Pass Plus rewards, one as an Otherworld Battle reward, and one more from the upcoming Event!

 

[October Update New Special Icon]

 

 

 

 

 

 

▣ New Uniform Collection

 

Check out the new Uniforms of the Marvel Studios’ <What If… Zombies?!> theme.

Complete the collection by achieving the specified conditions and earn a reward.

 

 

 

▣ Other Improvements and Changes

 

1. The [My Team] menu has been improved as follows.

 

▶ Instinct has been added to the Select Element Filter.

- You can use filters to find heroes that match each Instinct.

 

 

▶ The Custom Gear equipped for each hero can be checked.

- This can be checked at the bottom right of the hero portrait after checking ‘View Custom Gear Mode’.

 

 

2. ‘Update Hot Deals’ products have been added.

- Event Schedule:

After the 10/15 Maintenance - 11/12 (Tue) 14:59 (UTC+0),

After the 10/15 Maintenance - 11/12 (Tue) 6:59 (PST)

- The following products are available in the ‘Update Hot Deals’ category in the Store.

* The price is based on the Google Play Store.

 

 

 

* The Premium Comic Card Chest of ‘Hot Deal! Premium Comic Card Crafting Pack’ includes [Marvel Zombies Return (2009) #1] Premium Comic Card.

Artbook-themed Premium Comic Cards are not included.

 

 

 

 

3. The prices (Crystals) of 'Special Offers' products that can be purchased in each theme of Legendary Battle and Epic Quest have been lowered.

 

- Please check the detailed price change in-game.

 

4. The following features have been added to the Craft.

- Collection Tokens can be produced by using other types of Collection Tokens as materials.

- Runes can be produced by using other types of Runes as materials.

 

 

 

5. The order of Uniforms in the Uniform Shop and Hero Management screen has been changed to be displayed in the order of most recent.

 

6. The result screen will display the win and loss when the Auto Repeat ends in Otherworld Battle.

- Before: Displays the number of battle

- After: Displays the number of wins and loss

 

7. The Loyalty Points system is now applied at the [Store] - [Dimension Chest] - [Custom Gear Chest] 

when the <All C.T.P. Chance Up Event> is in progress.

- The loyalty points will increase if you don’t acquire the C.T.P. during the chance-up period from purchasing the Custom Gear Chest x10.

When the loyalty points are fully charged, one of the C.T.P. will be guaranteed upon purchasing the Custom Gear Chest x10 at a set rate.

* The loyalty points will reset upon acquiring the C.T.P.

* The loyalty points will reset when the current chance-up period ends and switches to the next.

* The loyalty point does not apply when purchasing the Custom Gear Chest x1.

 

8. The ‘What If? Ghost Rider (2018) #1’ has been added to the item list for the Premium Comic Card Chest, which can be purchased with the Premium Comic Card Exchange Token in the [Store] - [Dimension Chest].

 

9. The team lists set up by Alliance members in the Alliance Tournament now can be checked.

 

10. The background modeling of the "A.I.M. Headquarters" and "Weapon Facility, A.I.M. Research Complex" have been improved.

 

11. The C.T.P. of Conquest now can be acquired through the Dimension Chest: C.T.P. in the [Shadowland Shop] and [Battlefield Shop].

 

 

▣ Game Error Fixes

 

1. The Emblem effect is not applied to the stat information when viewing your hero from another account has been fixed.

 

2. The cooldown of the Fortitude options held by team members reset when a hero with the Fortitude effect appears as a Tier-4 Striker Skill during the battle has been fixed.

 

3. The remaining rewards quantity of Soul of the Faltine in the list of [Rewards Available] from the Giant Boss Raid is not displayed normally has been fixed.

 

4. Certain images of Super Villains in the Dispatch Mission Sector 4 are not displayed normally has been fixed.

 

5. Certain heroes would not move from specific locations during Auto-Battle during Story [Dimensional Clash] Ultimate 4-1 Stage has been fixed.

 

We will return with various content improvements, so please stay tuned.

 

Thank you.
